statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit. Homepage loaded, while representative internal routes exposed a reproducible Cloudflare challenge that is recorded as a user-facing issue rather than an untested blocker.

page.notes: Public Hindi-language editorial listing with article, category, video, search, and story-submission templates. A third-party AgeVerif gate covers the first viewport. Internal article/category/form routes were challenged in clean browser sessions.

checkOutcomes.method: Dark-mode screenshot plus computed-style and CSS media-rule probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark preference matched, but color-scheme stayed normal and the fixed light palette did not retint.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion probe plus animation inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The preference matched; no active animations were present and the only reduced-motion rule lengthens a form spinner.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS preference-rule inspection plus axe contrast test
checkOutcomes.evidence: No forced-colors/prefers-contrast handling was found and default text already includes a 3.32:1 failure.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature inspection across an MPA route inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: No View Transition CSS/API usage was found for article/listing/form navigation.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS and active-animation inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has no scroll-linked animation or parallax behavior to implement declaratively.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked motion exists on the audited listing.

checkOutcomes.method: Interaction and CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No swipe, pull-to-reveal, carousel, or other gesture-driven control exists on the audited template.
checkOutcomes.reason: The site exposes conventional links and menus, not physical gesture interactions.

checkOutcomes.method: Long-page layout metrics and CSS feature inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The listing is 10,814 px tall with no scroll-state-aware header/progress affordance.

checkOutcomes.method: Dropdown script inventory and anchor-positioning CSS probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site has dropdown navigation scripts but no CSS anchor positioning or position fallback rules.

checkOutcomes.method: Navigation inventory and transition/scroll-marker feature probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No directional transition, scroll marker, progress cue, or post-navigation highlight was present.

checkOutcomes.method: Load screenshots at desktop/mobile plus network/DOM ad inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: A full-screen age gate obscures all content while ad frames and media load behind it.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered DOM primitive and screenshot comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: No dialog/popover/details primitive represents the visually modal age gate; it is supplied by a third-party closed overlay.

checkOutcomes.method: Screenshot, DOM ad-frame inventory, and HAR
checkOutcomes.evidence: Age-verification chrome plus several advertising surfaces compete with a text-first reading experience.

checkOutcomes.method: 360x800 homepage layout metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: The actual homepage had viewport metadata, a 360 px scroll width, and zero horizontal overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Stylesheet feature inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No container query support was found for reusable card/sidebar/navigation components.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic focus and target-size probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focus exists on visible links, but many links are only 16–19 px high and hidden menu links can remain focusable at zero size.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport screenshots plus underlying heading/link inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The underlying page purpose is clear in DOM, but the first viewport reveals only an unexplained “Start” age-verification action.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct navigation to article, category, and submission routes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative primary routes were intercepted by Cloudflare verification and did not reach content/forms.

checkOutcomes.method: Challenge-state screenshots and route response inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The challenge explains security verification but offers no reliable fallback when article/form navigation is repeatedly challenged.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse plus trace/layout corroboration
checkOutcomes.evidence: Throttled Lighthouse LCP was 3.7 s (needs improvement), although CLS was 0 and trace TBT was 0.28 ms.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout-shift observer plus Lighthouse CLS
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both observed and Lighthouse CLS were 0 with no recorded shifts.

checkOutcomes.method: DevTools trace and long-task observer
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace found one 50.28 ms task and only 0.28 ms TBT; layout found one 53 ms task.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against live script attributes
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page transferred 2.86 MB, had nine parser-inserted render-blocking stylesheets and a non-deferred jQuery script, and fetched a 2.55 MB third-party MP4.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse code-coverage audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 57 KiB unused JS and 34 KiB unused CSS.

checkOutcomes.method: axe-core plus Lighthouse accessibility audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: Untitled ad frames and an unnamed focusable clickthrough link were found.

checkOutcomes.method: axe-core color contrast calculation
checkOutcomes.evidence: Site-description text measured 3.32:1 against its background.

checkOutcomes.method: axe landmark checks plus focus walk
checkOutcomes.evidence: Nested/duplicate landmarks and focusable zero-size hidden menu links were found.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop/mobile screenshots, DOM typography, and Lighthouse text audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: Visible underlying text uses scalable fonts and wraps without homepage horizontal overflow; no clipping was observed on the accessible homepage template.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile reflow metrics, viewport inspection, and target-size probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport scaling is allowed and homepage reflows, but numerous links are 16–19 px high.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse console-error audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: No browser console errors or uncaught exceptions were logged.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM, images primitive, and Lighthouse asset audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage has HTML doctype, UTF-8 charset, no img elements to mis-size, and passed image aspect/resolution audits.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse BFCache/source-map/deprecation audits and permission-state probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: BFCache and source maps passed; no notification/geolocation prompt fired on load and no deprecated API finding was reported.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM metadata probe and Lighthouse SEO
checkOutcomes.evidence: The public homepage has a descriptive title and meta description; Lighthouse SEO scored them as present.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM links/viewport, robots.txt, and Lighthouse SEO
checkOutcomes.evidence: Real href links, viewport metadata, index/follow robots, and valid robots.txt were present on the homepage.

checkOutcomes.method: Canonical/robots probe plus crawler fetch of an article
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage canonical/index signals are valid, but the representative article returned HTTP 403 and no crawlable content.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM JSON-LD and Open Graph inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage exposes one JSON-LD block and accurate Open Graph title, description, URL, locale, type, and site name.

checkOutcomes.method: Headers, cookie, secrets, and HTTPS probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS/nosniff/frame protection are present and no secret was found, but CSP is absent and naslvq is not Secure.

checkOutcomes.method: Trackers primitive and HAR third-party accounting
checkOutcomes.evidence: Twelve third-party origins and 2.66 MB third-party transfer occurred on initial load.

checkOutcomes.method: Permission-state and runtime feature probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No notification/geolocation prompt fired on load; no authentication surface exists on the audited public content paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Main-document security header audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, and Permissions-Policy exist, but CSP and Referrer-Policy are missing.

checkOutcomes.method: JS-disabled/raw-HTML comparison on homepage and article
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage raw HTML retained 93% content, but the article returned 403/0% and depends on challenge JavaScript/cookies.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct-route challenge screenshots and overlay behavior
checkOutcomes.evidence: Internal routes can be replaced by a verification overlay, preventing reliable article/form runtime behavior.

checkOutcomes.method: Manifest link and service-worker registration probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: A web app manifest link exists and an active service-worker registration covers the origin.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct-route HTTP/challenge state inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 403 challenge state describes verification but offers no dependable retry/fallback for blocked public content.

checkOutcomes.method: Root lang/dir and content-language inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: html lang is en-US while the primary editorial content is Hindi.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered date/count inspection against declared locale
checkOutcomes.evidence: Entries use fixed DD-MM-YYYY strings and western-grouped counters rather than locale-aware machine-readable presentation.

checkOutcomes.method: Content and data-surface inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited content listing exposes publication dates but no event times, appointments, recurring intervals, or time-zone-sensitive calculations.
checkOutcomes.reason: No time-zone-sensitive user task or data exists on the representative paths.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport age gate and ad accessibility inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The only gate action is “Start,” with no threshold, explanation, privacy detail, or exit; an ad clickthrough is unnamed.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct visit to the story-submission form
checkOutcomes.evidence: The representative form route was replaced by a Cloudflare challenge, so users cannot reach validation, errors, or recovery.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct visit and form DOM probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The story-submission form could not be reached from a clean session, preventing any autofill/input assistance.

checkOutcomes.method: Route and form inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: No checkout, subscription, authentication, or account-management flow is exposed on the audited public content site.
checkOutcomes.reason: No commercial or account flow is present in the representative route set.

checkOutcomes.method: Images primitive and HAR image accounting
checkOutcomes.evidence: No img elements were shipped; image transfer was only 2.2 KB and no oversized/legacy image issue was found.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR and trace of initial idle/load window
checkOutcomes.evidence: A 2.55 MB third-party MP4 and multiple ad/stat requests load before the user can access content.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR third-party/media budget analysis
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third parties account for 2.66 MB and the MP4 alone nearly 90% of all transfer.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/source capability probe and site-intent judgement
checkOutcomes.evidence: No agent-facing transaction/tool surface exists; this is a conventional editorial content site.
checkOutcomes.reason: No explicit agent-facing capability or developer intent was declared; emerging WebMCP tooling is not required for this site.

checkOutcomes.method: Script/API inventory and site-intent judgement
checkOutcomes.evidence: No user task requires on-device language-model or summarizer inference.
checkOutcomes.reason: The site is a direct content reader and has no inference-assisted workflow where built-in AI is necessary.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline heap then ten menu open/close cycles and post heap
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten menu cycles, heap self-size rose only 77,253 bytes (0.9%), objects fell 1345→1337, arrays stayed 292, and closures rose 8553→8563.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap summary plus DOM/JS heap probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page used about 8.7 MB heap self-size, 986 DOM elements, and 8.16 MB JSHeapUsedSize, proportionate for the loaded WordPress page.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after heap constructor comparison after repeated menu interaction
checkOutcomes.evidence: No Detached* constructor appeared in either top-constructor summary; object/array populations were flat and closure growth was only 10.

principleOutcomes.reason: No explicit agent-facing capability or developer intent was declared; emerging WebMCP tooling is not required for this site. The site is a direct content reader and has no inference-assisted workflow where built-in AI is necessary.

paths.description: Homepage/listing template and primary entry: desktop/mobile, preference emulation, accessibility, performance, security, network, crawler, and memory checks. Represents listing/search/navigation chrome.
Representative article/detail journey selected from the homepage. Direct clean-session navigation was intercepted by Cloudflare and returned HTTP 403 to the crawler.
Representative category/listing archetype selected from navigation; direct mobile visit exposed the Cloudflare verification state.
Primary contribution/form journey; direct mobile visit exposed the Cloudflare verification state before the form could be reached.

findings.summary: The site has no user-preference-driven dark theme.
findings.evidence: Under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark, the page remained rgb(227, 219, 190) with computed color-scheme "normal"; no dark media rule was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare light/dark support on the root and define adaptive surface and text tokens with color-scheme, prefers-color-scheme, or light-dark().

findings.summary: High-contrast and forced-color preferences are not handled.
findings.evidence: CSS capability inspection found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules, while axe found a 3.32:1 text contrast failure in the default theme.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations, preserve visible control boundaries, and use system colors where appropriate.

findings.summary: Page and state changes are abrupt.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition usage; this multi-page site changes among listings, articles, and forms without transition cues.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation with a no-motion fallback.

findings.summary: The long listing offers little position-aware navigation or attention guidance.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout is 10,814 CSS px tall, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state, scroll timeline, anchor positioning, or view-transition support; dropdown behavior is script-driven.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight sticky/scroll-state header or progress cue and use anchored positioning for dropdowns with edge fallbacks.

findings.summary: A full-screen age gate and ad-heavy page chrome obscure the primary content.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show the page completely dimmed behind a full-screen AgeVerif prompt. The rendered DOM also includes multiple ad iframes and a media ad.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the legally required age check, but explain the threshold and privacy implications, implement it as an accessible dialog, and load nonessential advertising only after access and consent.

findings.summary: Responsiveness is viewport-only rather than component-aware.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container rules despite reusable article cards, navigation groups, and sidebar widgets.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable cards/widgets containment and use size container queries where their layout varies independently of the viewport.

findings.summary: Many links have undersized touch targets and hidden navigation links can remain focusable.
findings.evidence: The interaction probe found many 16–19 px-high author, tag, comment, and read-more links, plus zero-size links in hidden navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least a 24×24 CSS px target (preferably 44×44 for primary controls), adequate spacing, and remove hidden menu descendants from the tab order.

findings.summary: Representative internal article and submission routes were blocked by a Cloudflare human-verification challenge.
findings.evidence: Direct browser visits to an article, category, and story-submission route returned “Just a moment”/“Performing security verification”; the article crawler fetch returned HTTP 403 with 0% content coverage.
findings.suggestedFix: Tune bot-management rules so normal navigation and legitimate crawlers can reach public routes, provide an accessible fallback, and monitor false-positive challenge rates.

findings.summary: Throttled loading misses the good LCP range and the page transfers disproportionate media.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.7 s, FCP 2.7 s, Speed Index 6.3 s. HAR recorded 2.86 MB transferred, including an unsolicited 2.55 MB third-party MP4.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or defer the media ad until user intent, prioritize the real LCP resource, and reduce render-blocking dependencies.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 57 KiB unused JavaScript and 34 KiB unused CSS; jQuery was about 70% unused and dashicons about 99% unused on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Conditionally enqueue WordPress plugin/theme assets only on pages that use them and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

findings.summary: Advertising frames and a clickthrough link lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: axe and Lighthouse found untitled iframes and a focusable .mol-vast-clickthrough link with no discernible text.
findings.suggestedFix: Title meaningful frames, mark decorative frames presentational, and give every focusable link an accurate accessible name.

findings.summary: The site description fails WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: axe measured #757575 on #e3dbbe at 3.32:1 for 15 px normal text; 4.5:1 is required.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the description text or adjust its background to achieve at least 4.5:1 contrast.

findings.summary: Landmark structure and focus exposure are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: axe found nested complementary landmarks and duplicate unlabeled landmarks; the focus probe reached zero-size hidden navigation links.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one clear main landmark, uniquely label repeated navigation/search landmarks, and inert/collapse hidden menus correctly.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie settings are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The main response had no CSP; cookie audit found naslvq without Secure or HttpOnly and with SameSite=None. HSTS, nosniff, X-Frame-Options, and Permissions-Policy were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP in report-only mode then enforce it, and set nonessential cookies Secure with an appropriate SameSite policy and short lifetime.

findings.summary: The homepage exposes visitors to a large, opaque third-party advertising footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker/network evidence found 12 third-party origins, 15 third-party requests, and 2.66 MB of third-party transfer; third parties include age verification, ad servers, stats, and live-content widgets.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory and minimize vendors, gate nonessential requests behind informed consent, sandbox frames, and defer/batch analytics.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policy coverage is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers lacked both Content-Security-Policy and Referrer-Policy. HSTS, clickjacking protection, nosniff, and a limited Permissions-Policy were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive Referrer-Policy and roll out nonce/hash-based CSP with frame-src/connect-src limited to reviewed vendors.

findings.summary: Public internal content can be served as a 403 challenge to crawlers and fresh browser sessions.
findings.evidence: The homepage had 93% raw-HTML coverage, but the representative article fetch returned HTTP 403 and 0% coverage; its rendered title became “Just a moment…” with no content metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow verified search/AI crawlers and ordinary navigation to public article routes, keep challenge URLs out of indexing, and test sitemap URLs from clean sessions.

findings.summary: Resilience is inconsistent across templates.
findings.evidence: The homepage exposes 93% of content without JavaScript, but representative article and form routes degrade to a JavaScript/cookie-dependent Cloudflare challenge and HTTP 403.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve server-rendered public content and ensure security controls fail open to a safe read-only experience or provide a clear accessible recovery path.

findings.summary: The document language does not match the predominantly Hindi content.
findings.evidence: The root element declares lang="en-US" while headings, summaries, and primary content are Hindi; this causes incorrect pronunciation and language handling.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the page/root language to hi (or hi-IN) and mark genuinely English fragments with lang="en".

findings.summary: Dates and counters are presented with a fixed mixed-locale convention.
findings.evidence: Homepage entries use fixed DD-MM-YYYY strings alongside western-grouped counts while the page declares en-US despite Hindi content.
findings.suggestedFix: Store machine-readable dates and render them with Intl.DateTimeFormat/NumberFormat for the chosen Hindi locale.

findings.summary: The age gate and ad click surfaces do not provide enough context for an informed choice.
findings.evidence: The gate offers only “Start”, without stating an age threshold, what verification entails, privacy consequences, or an exit action; axe also found an unnamed ad clickthrough.
findings.suggestedFix: State the required age and verification/privacy terms plainly, offer an exit path, and clearly distinguish advertisements from editorial navigation.

findings.summary: Third-party media dominates the resource budget before the user reaches content.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded a 2.55 MB third-party MP4, accounting for nearly 90% of the 2.86 MB transferred, while a full-screen age gate still covered the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not fetch or autoplay heavy ad media before age verification and user intent; use static placeholders and load media on interaction.

taskList.title: Stop false-positive Cloudflare challenges on public articles, categories, and the submission route
Defer/remove pre-access third-party media and minimize advertising/tracking vendors
Make age verification explicit, accessible, privacy-aware, and clearly separate ads
Deploy CSP/Referrer-Policy and fix insecure cookie attributes
Fix accessible names, landmark structure, contrast, hidden focus, and touch target sizes
Set correct Hindi language/locale metadata and locale-aware dates/numbers
Add user-preference theming and contrast-mode adaptations
Trim unused WordPress CSS/JS and modernize navigation/responsive behavior
